newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MULTICHOICE SAYS TO OFFER MTV ON SATELLITE.
newsitem.headline: MULTICHOICE SAYS TO OFFER MTV ON SATELLITE.

text.p: Multichoice said on Friday it had signed a deal with MTV Europe to offer the MTV youth music channel as part of its digital satellite package.

"MTV is the most well-known music and youth orientated television service in the world and we are delighted to be able to include MTV Europe in our (satellite television) offering," Multichoice chief executive officer Hans Hawinkels said in a statement.
William H. Roedy, International MTV Networks president, said in announcing the deal that it was a step towards the development of a MTV service targetted at South Africa.

"This is a significant step in MTV's plans for South Africa, which includes the development of a MTV service for South Africa in association with the respected South African artist Johnny Clegg," Roedy said.
The addition of MTV lifts to 73 the number of Multichoice's channels on offer.
